answer_sentences.text: No. Under the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, the bank shall not levy charges or fees retrospectively at the time of pre-payment of loans if those charges were waived earlier, so a fee forgiven when the personal loan was sanctioned cannot be recovered at loan closure.
answer_sentences.quote: "A UCB shall not levy any charges/ fees retrospectively at the time of pre- payment of loans, which were waived off earlier by the UCB."
